notes: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden; no online trophies; platinum about 200 hours at difficulty 4/10 per PowerPyx; names and descriptions are the official list via PSNProfiles and Exophase; every guide is written in our own words and names its sources.

trophies.guide: This is the platinum itself, and it asks for nothing on its own: the moment the other 54 trophies have all popped, this one follows by itself. There is no online play in the set, no DLC requirement, and no extra challenge hiding behind it — the whole list is offline single-player, so the platinum is simply a matter of working through the other 54 in whatever order suits you.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops

trophies.guide: A story trophy that arrives on its own: play Gone Fishing, the opening main mission of Chapter 1, through to the end and it pops. Story trophies cannot be missed, since there is no mission replay — the game hands it over as soon as the mission is done.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play Chapter 1 and finish the mission Gone Fishing

trophies.guide: Another automatic one: work through every main mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy arrives as Chapter 2 opens, just after the first Chapter 2 mission gets underway — so keep playing past the chapter card rather than stopping at it.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Complete all Chapter 1 main missions
Start Chapter 2 and the trophy pops

trophies.guide: Play through the whole of Chapter 2 and this pops as Chapter 3 begins, shortly after the opening Chapter 3 mission Welcome to Vice City starts moving. No side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Complete all Chapter 2 main missions
Begin Chapter 3 and the trophy pops

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 and this one lands a little later than you might expect: it pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so the chapter card on its own is not the trigger — keep playing into Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Complete all Chapter 3 main missions
Play the first two Chapter 4 missions (Ocean Beach, Another Life)

trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 4 to its end and the trophy pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero. From here only the final chapter stands between you and the story gold.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Complete all Chapter 4 main missions, ending with Starting From Zero

trophies.guide: One of only two golds, and it comes automatically: finish the final mission of the story in Chapter 5 and it pops, opening free-roam and the 100% completion checklist under Progress, Stats. This is the last story trophy — everything after it is cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete the final story mission
Free-roam opens afterwards for the 100% checklist

trophies.guide: A mission-named story trophy that pops during the ending of Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 main mission. Like every trophy tied to a mission name, it cannot be missed — finishing the mission is all it takes.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play Chapter 2 and finish the mission Breakfast Run

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission, and this pops. Heist missions are story beats, so just follow the pink mission markers and it arrives on its own.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play Chapter 3 and finish the mission The Cartel Heist

trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission, and the trophy is yours. As with every mission-named trophy, the award is for completing the mission — nothing extra is asked.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play Chapter 4 and finish the mission Child's Play

trophies.guide: Finish Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission, and this pops. Keep following the story and it comes on its own — there is nothing to hunt down for it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play Chapter 4 and finish the mission Headliners

trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission set at the airport, and the trophy pops. The airport setting also introduces the area you will come back to for the Catch Me If You Can trophy.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play Chapter 4 and finish the mission VCIA Takedown

trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission, and this pops. It is the last mission-named trophy before the finale.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play Chapter 5 and finish the mission Operation Savage Glory

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the second gold. Once the story is done, the 100% checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — and progress you made during the story already counts toward it. Do not let the name fool you: it is far from true 100%, closer to 60% of the game, with most side quests not required and collectibles only partly needed. What needs everything: all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges, all drone races and all of Bret's quests. The partial targets are 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, 300 stunts, 100 optional missions and 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing on the checklist is missable — it can all be done in post-story free-roam.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion)
Clear every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest
Reach the partial targets — 200 vehicles, 100 animals, 300 stunts, 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida, mixing the four types however you like — 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. The under-bridge flights are the quickest to farm. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250. Track progress per region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and see found stunts on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Do any 250 stunts across the four types (jumps, under-bridge, knife flights, base jumps)
Under-bridge flights are the fastest to farm
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress, Activities to see which types are done; the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) marks most of them. You will do one of each almost automatically while working on the other trophies, so this usually pops on its own.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open Progress, Activities to see the 9 types and which are done
Do one of each type — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, video game, a race, a stunt

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 shooting range locations. The golds are not too hard, and they are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes with that grind. Practising here also raises your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit all 12 shooting range locations
Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total across them. The drone races are required in full for the 100% checklist too, so this trophy is really the same job counted twice. Learn each course's line first with a slow run, then push for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations
Win at least one race at every location (42 races total)

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many to choose from as you need — pick the short, easy ones first and only race each location once, since repeats do not count. Race locations are marked on the map once the area is unfogged.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Find race locations on the map (40 unique spots)
Win 20 different races — repeats at the same spot do not count

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge he sets. The questline unlocks through that text, so watch your phone after Feng Shui rather than hunting for Cal on your own.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Finish Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (meet Cal)
Wait for Cal's text, then follow the purple fishing marker
Beat Cal in his fishing challenge

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game) — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, from Chapter 1, while Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game — beating every side challenge is not required. Pick the game you find easiest and play it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Pick one of the 4 video games (3 at the home TV, 1 at arcade machines)
Play through all its levels to the end

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. All five quests stay available after the story: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). The last one pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: In Chapter 3 as Lucia, take Andy's call and follow her text to Belville
Complete all 5 Andy quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline of treasure diving — 7 shipwrecks in total. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1, and after the mission Island Dreams he calls you; his green KR icon sits in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map — dive down, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back. Kenton goes quiet for a while in Chapter 1, but he returns in Chapters 2–3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), so nothing is missable. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Take Kenton's call after Island Dreams
Find his KR icon in Key Lento
Clear all 7 shipwreck treasure dives, returning each haul to Kenton

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. All five quests stay available after the story: Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. The last one pops the trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: After Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub
Complete all 5 Billy quests, ending with Hometown Heroes

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands — but only certain questlines count. Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing mentor) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and his deliveries) count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy even though they are side quests. All strangers are still findable in post-story free-roam, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Find stranger questlines in the open world (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete are confirmed)
Finish 8 strands that count — named-character questlines do not count

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List — deliver 16 sports cars he wants. It unlocks in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end cars. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List; Randy marks some cars in fixed spots, but you can also steal them off the street — scanning a car with the WAiNK app shows whether it is on the list. Deliver each to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City); a car in good condition pays more. All of it can be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Unlock the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS
Steal and deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is Jason-only. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City, which you destroy in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest Spin On This (shut down the labs), and finishing it pops the trophy. It all stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: After Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty (as Jason), destroy the Synthetic Labs
Complete Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: This is the only trophy in the set that might be missable, so read it carefully. Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location, and you cannot do the final one until both characters can play together (after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break). Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. The warning: one meditation is only available in Chapter 1 at Jason's house — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she says she will meditate, and choose Accept. That session raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so PowerPyx cannot yet confirm whether the trophy needs it. Do it anyway, before leaving Chapter 1. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.
trophies.missable_note: Potentially missable: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, cannot be repeated after Chapter 1. PowerPyx has not confirmed whether it is required for the trophy — do it anyway.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: CHAPTER 1 — after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, choose Accept
Meditate at all 18 spots (10 locations), with both Jason and Lucia where possible
Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Do Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is Jason-only. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Bret then marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker); one clean shot leaves a kill in pristine condition and pays more, but is not required. Track the hunts under Map, Activities, Target Deck — all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100%, so this trophy comes naturally on the way. It is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: After Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, take Bret's text and meet him (Veteran Hunted)
Hunt the animals Bret requests and bring them to him

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered around Leonida; you only need three sets, so pick the sets whose cards cluster near places you already visit for other trophies. Cards are a pure collectible hunt — no mission or character unlock gates them.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Find collectible cards around Leonida (18 sets exist)
Complete any 3 full sets

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots by holding Up and then R1 while looking at them — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count, and there are more than 100 in the world, so any 100 will do. The pool breaks down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures plus No Flusher tags. Make scanning a habit from Chapter 1: every new vehicle and spot you scan also feeds the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 to scan)
Scan any 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures or tags

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there. Track challenges under Progress, Challenges, where a checkmark shows each completed one. Leave the hardest challenges for last and pick the easiest 50 first — most will already be done naturally from working on the other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Work through challenges (Progress, Challenges)
Complete any 50 of 80
Keep going to 70 for 100%

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner with Right on the D-pad plus Triangle. The easiest escape is a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic, or the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, call your partner to your side
Reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone (train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well)

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you (available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break), rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — keep the flashing red/blue wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation and healing items (Zombix or Adrenaline). The recommended run is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, unlocked after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each, break the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and if the pop does not come after the third shop, hit a fourth — the unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Call your partner, then rob a first shop and stay wanted
Rob 2 more shops back-to-back without losing the wanted level
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop; hit a 4th if it has not popped

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK phone app (hold Up to open it instantly): look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, so stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy pops automatically on that road.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan vehicles (hold R1 while looking at one)
Discover 100 different vehicles
Keep going to 200 base models for 100%

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus — aim a firearm and press L3 + R3 to slow time and highlight weak spots. The focus bar (purple, top-left under health and stamina) only lasts a few seconds, so prepare first — eat or drink, or shower at home, to buff focus, and take Adrenaline to extend it. The recommended setup is lining up 5 gang members at a Gang Operation with an assault rifle like the Duke 556, wearing body armor so you can step out of cover; the trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Focus) and rises from shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by endgame you will likely be at level 4 and this comes naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Buff focus (food, drink, shower) and take Adrenaline
Find 5 grouped gang enemies, trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and drop all 5

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane sitting on the airfield. The plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops (the unlock is slightly delayed).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and reach the large plane docked at terminal E3/E4
Board via the stairs by the boarding bridge, enter the cockpit, reverse out and take off
Fly at least 1 km from the airport

trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the base, so be ready to fight your way out.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station (south-west island, Mariana County)
Enter a Rhino tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Then break into a jewelry store through its back door using the Snap Gun (the prompt offers kicking the door, which triggers the alarm, or the Snap Gun for the stealth approach), find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe without being detected. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun
Enter a jewelry store via the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code and loot the safe undetected

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape each time. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, follow the guard's briefcase into the vault while it is open, grab the cash (bring your partner and hand off a bag with Right on the D-pad) and escape. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip (after his earlier quests, including 2 Payday Loan robberies) to mark security vans with purple icons. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level — a fast motorcycle and a switch to another vehicle afterwards are the escape tips. All 8 vaults are needed for 100%, so this silver comes automatically.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
steps: Finish Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is
Buy Yasmani's security-van tips ($10,000 each) and rob any 5 of the 8 bank vaults, escaping each time

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since tailing the security van to a bank vault counts as the truck robbery. To get it earlier, find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Either finish Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, or block an armored truck, sticky-bomb its back door, loot it and escape the heat radius

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map — visit all 52 areas of Leonida as the PSN tracker counts them. The fastest method is a plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible. Do it late, once you have a plane and the whole map is open, and sweep the islands and the far corners last.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Get a plane
Fly over every fogged part of the map until all 52 areas are revealed

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this bronze pops automatically on that road. Operations are marked by yellow icons when you go near them (many are also marked automatically through story progress), and you can track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find illegal operations (yellow map icons)
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs
All 39 are needed for 100%

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, so no verified method exists yet. The description itself is the only lead: have a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach. Try the beachfront bars along Ocean Beach and order a drink while facing the water; if a prompt or a specific bar appears, that is the trigger. Treat any method read elsewhere as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown)
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and try ordering a cocktail at a beachfront bar with a view
No verified unlock is published yet — PowerPyx lists this as currently unknown

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, so no verified method exists yet. The description points at a vehicle showroom: the classic-style smash-out means driving a car through the showroom's front glass from inside. Try it at a vehicle showroom in Vice City once you have a car inside or can drive one in. Treat any method read elsewhere as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown)
steps: Find a vehicle showroom and try driving a car out through its front glass
No verified unlock is published yet — PowerPyx lists this as currently unknown

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation, so buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first, since you need them to blow the safe. The three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. You first go there in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but it is not missable: if you miss an item, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for what is left.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling)
Take the luxury watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe loot (sticky bombs)
Escape the police — the trophy pops after the escape

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise Strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership and always train together: call your partner (Right on the D-pad plus Triangle) and while one character works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Check Strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, per character (heart icon). Fitness clubs are filterable on the map under Activities (dumbbell icon), and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: After Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, get a fitness club membership
Work out with both characters together until both reach maximum Strength

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the PSN tracker counts up to 500. Turn on the notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On): a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something counts. The profile runs Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable (permanent, from excessive violence — avoid it, since cops then shoot on sight far more). It comes passively from robberies and fights while chasing the other trophies; if it is your last one, it can be farmed quickly, though that pushes your profile toward the harsher tiers.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications)
Play normally — robberies and encounters count
Reach 500 profile actions

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description (second time's the charm) suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. Try the Payday Loans storefront and any second-attempt interaction there. Treat any method read elsewhere as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown)
steps: Try the Payday Loans store from the prologue — a second attempt is the suspected trigger
No verified unlock is published yet — PowerPyx lists this as currently unknown

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. The description reads like a strange encounter, so the lead is the UFO-related side content around Leonida — keep an eye out for strange lights or a stranger quest that turns weird. Treat any method read elsewhere as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown)
steps: Look for UFO-related side content and strange encounters around Leonida
No verified unlock is published yet — PowerPyx lists this as currently unknown

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

Try it on a lone enemy on a quiet road so you can line the kick up. Treat any method read elsewhere as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through fences. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not one delivery. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally while doing the vaults for Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer
Rob banks and Payday Loans
Deliver $250,000 total in marked bills to a fence

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types — the total is cumulative, so normal shopping counts. The fastest way is the most expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods and tattoos. The shop pool counts 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. It pops on its own if you gear up properly for the other trophies.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend $100,000 total across any shops
Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, for $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy through the app. The 4 story-related garages do not count — only the 8 purchasable ones. Robberies are the quickest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Finish Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app ($160,000 total)

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). The app lets you summon registered stolen vehicles to your location. You need garage parking spots first (see Little Boxes — each garage adds spots), then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register in his garage. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Finish Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app and Moses
Buy garage spots, then drive 10 stolen vehicles to Moses and Register them
